attempts.text:
The plan below costs 460: 400 driving minutes plus 60 for three deferred adults.

- **Car2 is unusable.** The only road into Dhunche hospital, from Dupcheshwar care home, is buried by the landslide, so car2 cannot leave. Nobody is waiting at Dhunche, so car1 does all the work and every drop-off is at Trishuli shelter.
- **Unusable roads.** I treated the Syaphru–Uttargaya bridge, the Dhunche–Dupcheshwar road, the Uttargaya–Shivapuri road and the Benighat–Gajuri road as unusable. I counted the flooded Benighat–Gajuri road as unusable because a truck was swept off it this morning.
- **Bidur temple.** It is not a designated evacuation point, so I did not use it.
- **Assumption.** I read "two men and women" at Tarkeshwar market as 2 adults.
- **Deferred.** Three adults, one at Tarkeshwar market and two at Jwalamukhi market, are deferred. Another trip to fetch them would cost more than the 60 penalty.
